project_type: Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite SPA with Supabase backend (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage)
build_system: Vite 5.0, npm workspaces. Frontend in frontend/, migrations in supabase/migrations/
test_framework: Vitest 2.0 for unit tests (src/**/*.{test,spec}.ts), Playwright 1.44 for E2E (tests/e2e/*.spec.ts), jsdom 30.1 environment
test_command: cd frontend && npm run test (unit), npm run test:e2e (E2E)
verification_instructions: 1. Build: cd frontend && npm run build (must compile without errors). 2. Unit tests: cd frontend && npm run test (all tests pass). 3. E2E tests: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e (requires live Supabase instance with migrations). 4. Supabase check: cd frontend && npm run check:supabase (no missing-table errors). 5. Dev server: cd frontend && npm run dev, open http://127.0.0.1:5173, navigate to /journal/new, verify Decorate toggle visible and functional.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Vite outputs to frontend/dist/ (excluded from git). Migrations are hand-written SQL, not generated.
environment_constraints: Never use service_role key in frontend code. Supabase URL/anon key in frontend/.env (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY). RLS policies enforce all authorization. Signed URLs generated server-side (Supabase Edge Functions or Data API). Moveable version 0.53.0 already installed; use its Vue integration pattern.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Inferred from codebase: (1) Follow existing file structure (types in src/types/, services in src/services/, components in src/components/, composables in src/composables/). (2) Use Supabase RLS pattern: authenticated users, owner_access policy (user_id = auth.uid() AND is_account_active()). (3) Migration naming: YYYYMMDDNNNNNN_description.sql. (4) TypeScript strict mode, no any types. (5) Tailwind utility classes, match Cronevia aesthetic (cream #f5ebdd, burgundy #7B0323, pastel accents). (6) All interactive elements need ARIA labels. (7) Test coverage for new composables and components.
key_patterns: Pinia stores for state (defineStore, ref, computed). Services return typed responses or throw with { response: { status, data: { message } } }. Supabase client imported from @/lib/supabase. Components use <script setup lang="ts">. Reactive refs with .value. Props with defineProps<Props>(), emits with defineEmits<Emits>(). Route guards with onBeforeRouteLeave. Dirty state tracking for unsaved changes. PhotoUpload.vue pattern for file uploads with validation. CrnButton.vue, CrnInput.vue for styled UI primitives.
directory_structure: frontend/src/: assets/, components/ (ui/, journal/), layouts/, lib/ (supabase.ts), pages/ (JournalEditorPage.vue), router/, services/ (api.service.ts, supabase-api.ts), stores/ (auth.ts, journal.ts, trips.ts, memories.ts, dashboard.ts), types/ (index.ts, database.types.ts). frontend/public/: static assets. supabase/migrations/: SQL files. frontend/tests/e2e/: Playwright specs.
